mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_yak_ops_user_preference (user_id, scene, item_key, favorite, sort_order, use_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scene}, #{itemKey}, #{favorite}, #{sortOrder}, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE favorite = VALUES(favorite), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO t_yak_ops_user_preference (user_id, scene, item_key, favorite, sort_order, use_count, last_used_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scene}, #{itemKey}, 0, 0, 1, NOW(3), NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE use_count = use_count + 1, last_used_time = VALUES(last_used_time), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO t_yak_ops_user_preference (user_id, scene, item_key, favorite, sort_order, use_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scene}, #{itemKey}, #{favorite}, #{sortOrder}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (user_id, scene, item_key) DO UPDATE SET favorite = EXCLUDED.favorite, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time

INSERT INTO t_yak_ops_user_preference (user_id, scene, item_key, favorite, sort_order, use_count, last_used_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scene}, #{itemKey}, FALSE, 0, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (user_id, scene, item_key) DO UPDATE SET use_count = t_yak_ops_user_preference.use_count + 1, last_used_time = EXCLUDED.last_used_time, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time

MERGE INTO t_yak_ops_user_preference AS target USING (SELECT CAST(#{userId} AS INTEGER) AS user_id, CAST(#{scene} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS scene, CAST(#{itemKey} AS VARCHAR(128)) AS item_key) AS source ON target.user_id = source.user_id AND target.scene = source.scene AND target.item_key = source.item_key WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET favorite = #{favorite}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, scene, item_key, favorite, sort_order, use_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (source.user_id, source.scene, source.item_key, #{favorite}, #{sortOrder}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

MERGE INTO t_yak_ops_user_preference AS target USING (SELECT CAST(#{userId} AS INTEGER) AS user_id, CAST(#{scene} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS scene, CAST(#{itemKey} AS VARCHAR(128)) AS item_key) AS source ON target.user_id = source.user_id AND target.scene = source.scene AND target.item_key = source.item_key WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET use_count = target.use_count + 1, last_used_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, scene, item_key, favorite, sort_order, use_count, last_used_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (source.user_id, source.scene, source.item_key, FALSE, 0, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
